comment.comment:
$ORBIO | From Building Infrastructure to Powering Other Ecosystems. 🪐

Something interesting is happening at https://x.com/orbiodotso.

Earlier today, I wrote about Orbio's accelerating AI usage and the question that matters most:

Where will sustainable demand come from?

Now we have two developments worth watching.

1. CREDIT is live on Solana.

Solana wallets can now access and activate CREDIT as API balance on Orbio, unlocking access to 400+ AI models and privacy options.

This opens the door for Solana-based agents and applications to use Orbio's inference infrastructure.

Importantly, this is CREDIT expanding to Solana, not a migration of the $ORBIO token.

2. Forever × Orbio.

https://x.com/forevercultfund has announced a partnership with Orbio to power the intelligence behind its autonomous economy.

Orbio is becoming Forever's inference provider.

And this is where things get particularly interesting.

Imagine dozens, then hundreds, of independent AI-agent ecosystems using the same underlying infrastructure to think, execute and operate.

Orbio wouldn't need to build every successful agent. It could provide the intelligence infrastructure those agents depend on.

That's a fundamentally different opportunity.

But let's distinguish announcements from results.

Integrations don't automatically create revenue. Partnerships don't guarantee adoption. And growing CREDIT usage doesn't necessarily translate into proportional value for $ORBIO holders.

What I want to see next:
• Real inference usage from Solana
• Measurable activity from Forever's agents
• Recurring CREDIT demand
• Sustainable fees and demonstrable token value capture

I'm still holding $ORBIO and recently added during the correction.

Today hasn't proven the billion-dollar thesis.

But it has shown another possible path toward it.

The infrastructure is expanding.

Now let's see who actually uses it. 🪐
